author: José García Yeste
description:
Support for Sensirion SGP30 Air Quality Sensor.
Returns the CO2 in ppm and TVOC in ppb.

Based on: https://github.com/adafruit/Adafruit_SGP30/blob/master/Adafruit_SGP30.cpp

author: MicroBlocks
description:
STEM I2C color sensor (VEML6040).

Hue return -1 and color return gray when sensing black, white, or gray.

Technical info:
https://www.vishay.com/en/product/84276/

author: José García Yeste
description:
Support for VL53L0X distance sensor.
TOF laser based.
Range 3-200mm.

Tested on:
https://shop.m5stack.com/products/tof-sensor-unit (take Kapton tape on sensor!)
